title: Protocol structure
body_text:
The protocol will last about 35 minutes and is organized as follows.


To continue your familiarization with the task and the interface, you will enter the acclimation phase, which consists of two tasks of 5 images each.

Then, you will start the preparation phase for the main experiment, which will consist of 2 tasks of 7 questions each. The tasks will be very similar to the tasks of the main experiment. This phase will conclude the introduction

Then, the main experiment will start. It will be divided into 2 main sessions. Each session consists in solving 4 tasks of 14 questions each, that will count towards your score and bonus remuneration. Every 2 tasks, you will have to answer a small survey about the tasks you just performed.

Finally, you will enter the closing phase, in which you will have to answer a final survey to conclude the protocol.

Please note that your actions and answers will only be recorded during the Main experimental phase and the Closing phase, and that the tasks that count towards your performance and bonus remuneration are all part of the Main experimental phase.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions
